title: Dead pets dumping in Bulacan: Senators seek tougher measures; probe set

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Several senators are seeking to strengthen existing laws against animal cruelty as they condemned the dumping of the remains of several animals in San Jose Del Monte, Bulacan. They are also conducting an inquiry into the incident involving Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium in Bacoor City, Cavite, which was allegedly behind the dumping of the animal remains. The senators also called on authorities and concerned agencies to thoroughly investigate the incident and ensure that those responsible are held accountable. “We will look into this matter in aid of legislation to determine what gaps need to be addressed and […]...
